chars.N: NARJIS: a young woman wearing a burgundy blazer over a cream blouse, black trousers, a small gold pendant necklace, a tan leather handbag.
chars.K: KARIM: a man wearing a mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a black t-shirt, light-blue ripped jeans, white sneakers, a silver wristwatch.
chars.A: AMINE: a man wearing a navy-blue quilted vest over a light-grey long-sleeve shirt, dark-brown chino trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At night in a Casablanca residential street, NARJIS walks secretly beside KARIM toward the entrance of an apartment building, glancing nervously over her shoulder, he holds the door open for her.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: KARIM sits alone in a car at night in Casablanca, smirking slyly with narrowed eyes, his phone glowing in his hand, scheming expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small modern office, KARIM proudly shows a job offer on his phone to NARJIS, she looks shocked and hurt, a city skyline of Casablanca through the window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a parked car at night, NARJIS grabs KARIM's arm and pleads with tears in her eyes, KARIM looks away coldly, annoyed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KARIM lies on a sofa in his messy bachelor apartment, secretly smiling while texting on his phone, a framed photo of the old city of Fes medina gate on the wall.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: KARIM paces in his dark apartment at night, hand on his chin, thinking hard, worried and calculating, a city window behind him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a cafe, while NARJIS has turned away to talk to a waiter, KARIM sneakily picks up her phone from the table and looks at it with a sly face.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan living room with a sedari sofa, AMINE stands frozen holding his phone, staring at the screen in total shock, mouth open, eyes wide.
